prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t look up live business listings from here, but I can tell you the best ways to find and vet backflow testing and repair services near Liberty, MO — and what to expect.

Where to look
- Ask the City of Liberty Utilities or your water department — they often keep a list of approved/certified backflow testers and can tell you any local registration or reporting requirements.
- Google Maps / Yelp / Angi / HomeAdvisor — search “backflow testing Liberty MO” or “backflow prevention testing Kansas City area.”
- Local plumbing and irrigation companies — many plumbers and sprinkler companies in the Liberty/Kansas City area offer testing and repairs.
- Trade directories — check state or local plumbing associations or your county public works page for certified testers.

What to verify when you call
- Certification: ask whether the technician is a certified backflow tester and what certifying program they use.
- Insurance and licensure: confirm business license and liability insurance.
- Reporting: will they submit the test report to the city/water utility (some utilities require this)?
- Equipment: ask if they bring a calibrated test kit and can provide a written test report.
- Warranty: ask about warranty on repairs and replacement parts.

Typical price range (estimate)
- Testing only: roughly $60–$150 per device (varies by region and device complexity).
- Repairs: simple parts/labor may run $75–$300; major repairs or replacement can be several hundred dollars to $1,000+ depending on the device and valve condition.

What information to provide when you contact a company
- Address and exact location of the backflow device (meter vault, irrigation line, building service)
- Device type and size (if known)
- Whether it’s a residential irrigation, commercial, or fire-line backflow preventer
- Any urgency (e.g., failed test or leak)

If you want, tell me your ZIP code or allow me to perform a web search and I can list specific nearby companies and their contact info (I’ll need you to confirm you want me to look them up). I can also draft a short message or phone script you can use when contacting testers.
